response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and polyglot development skills with a focus on testability and user experience, but his experience lacks depth in C++ and large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, which are critical for this role. His leadership and mentoring experience is present but not explicitly tied to cloud or DevOps engineering, and his technical strategy contributions are more product-focused than platform-focused.
strengths: Extensive experience in software design, architecture, and mentoring across multiple domains (web, mobile, desktop, embedded).
Proven track record of technical leadership, including organizing workshops, talks, and setting up dev-ops infrastructure.
Strong open-source contributions and experience with distributed systems and real-time data processing.
concerns: Only limited and indirect experience with C++ (e.g., National Instruments role 10+ years ago), falling short of the 8-year requirement.
Lacks explicit experience with cloud compute platforms or production-level cloud architecture (AWS/CDK usage is for product work, not platform engineering).
Leadership experience is more collaborative and mentoring-focused rather than owning technical strategy for a cloud compute platform.
